text: The six consumed rows are built and tested against their documented use and a placeholder operation name: the rwb-source-data data-product read of the appraisal and the acceptance, the rwb-integration order submission, the rwb-integration interface-run read, the rwb-case case-state read, the rwb-decision rule-in-force and decision-log read, and the rwb-access authorise call. The SVAF order is modelled as an interface run of rwb-integration, and no file, transport or endpoint is assumed for it.
why: No source document publishes these operation names or the SVAF interface, and the baseline and the application story may not block on five neighbours to start on Day 1.
